authority: ROOT permits existing D03 OS record only; no target launch or fence change
filenameProfile: UTC or America/Chicago(CDT UTC-05) only as coarse name filter; header launch/capture times authoritative. Other names never retained or logged.
headerMatch: pid+process+exact path+parent when present; launch and capture within historical window +/-1000ms for report precision, narrower than approved +/-120s inventory.
recordPublication: Selected whitelisted fields only; full record transiently parsed in memory, bounded streamed SHA256; no raw record/header copied.
stop: No match/denied/ambiguous/oversized/integrity/capture/retirement => STOP; no other directories/logs/process probes
